subject: Mental Models
title: Affect Heuristic
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Affect Heuristic.

hook.text: People told nuclear power is clean like it more. Told it is dangerous and they hate it. Same technology.

buildup.text: The affect heuristic means we make judgments based on current emotions rather than objective analysis.

discovery.text: If something feels good, we judge its risks as low and its benefits as high. Feeling overrules thinking.

twist.text: Stock traders in good weather make more optimistic bets.

climax.text: Before big decisions, check your emotional state. Ask: am I choosing this because of evidence or because of how I feel?

punchline.text: Feelings vote before logic speaks. Hear both.

quiz.question: How does the affect heuristic influence risk assessment?
options: Positive feelings make risks seem lower and benefits seem higher
It has no effect on risk judgment
